trust_decision.summary: Whether a client-supplied file name may be stored on the media disk is decided only by FileAdder::defaultSanitizer, which at the pinned commit rejects only names whose final suffix is one of 8 PHP extensions (interior segments like shell.php.jpg, .pht/.shtml/.htaccess etc. pass).

landing_point.why: The only place in the tree with an extension blocklist and the FileNameNotAllowed throw; summary 'file upload restriction bypass' leads straight here.

fix_sites.entry_point: HasMedia::addMedia/addMediaFromRequest/addMediaFromUrl/addMediaFromDisk/addMediaFromBase64 -> FileAdder::toMediaCollection / toMediaCollectionFromRemote (sanitizer closure at FileAdder.php:73, called at :320 and :358)

published config file; new keys disallowed_extensions / allowed_extensions read by FileAdder::disallowedExtensions() with in-code fallback when cached config lacks the key (fix.diff:27-41, fix.diff:202-213)
exception thrown from the sanitizer; message-only change (fix.diff:103-111)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: config/media-library.php:41 (fix adds disallowed_extensions/allowed_extensions here, fix.diff:21-41) plus in-code fallback when config is cached without the key (fix.diff:202-206)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Renaming via $media->file_name + save() (MediaObserver -> Filesystem::renameMediaFile) is a developer-side model update, not an 'upload', and runs after the file is already stored, so a solver can argue the upload sanitizer was never meant to cover it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate multi-dot names (archive.tar.gz, backup.2026.05.zip, Scan-9.14.2022-7.23.28.pdf) and names merely ending in 'php' without a dot (media-libraryJQwPHp) must still be accepted; legitimate renames (test-new-name.jpg) must keep moving the file and its conversions.

O6_input_shapes: dangerous extension as final suffix (shell.phtml, shell.php6, shell.pht)
invisible/control chars removed before check (filename.php + U+200E)
config entries with leading dot or upper case (normalizeExtensions)

O7_producer.where: src/MediaCollections/FileAdder.php:321 and :359 call app(config('media-library.file_namer'))->originalFileName() and appendExtension (src/MediaCollections/FileAdder.php:633-638) after the sanitizer; default at src/Support/FileNamer/FileNamer.php:10-17

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Media rename: setting $media->file_name (Media is fully mass-assignable) and save() renames the stored file on disk with no extension check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Documented as a model-level rename feature (docs/basic-usage/retrieving-media.md:63-68), not an upload; file already passed the add-time check.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 2 files away from landing point (Observers/MediaObserver.php, Filesystem.php), same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Configured file_namer->originalFileName() and appendExtension rebuild the stored name after the sanitizer ran; a custom namer can reintroduce a disallowed segment unchecked.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: File namer is a user-supplied extension point; default namer only strips the final extension.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point; default implementation in src/Support/FileNamer/FileNamer.php

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Guard in renameMediaFile/syncFileNames reusing the add-time extension check, or a planted rename helper on Media that bypasses it.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Rename writes a new name to disk and is a natural place a maintainer would forget the upload guard.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Check performed on the sanitizer's output while the stored name is produced later by the file namer (rename-after-check, how-type).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Sanitizer and namer are separate configurable stages; maintainers placed the guard inside the replaceable sanitizer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: addMediaFromUrl derives the name via urldecode and appends a MIME subtype as extension when none is present; a sibling deriving the name after usingFileName would skip the check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Name derivation from URL/MIME is ad hoc and lives in a different file from the guard.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: sanitizingFileName() replaces the whole default sanitizer, including the guard; a fix could keep the guard mandatory outside the sanitizer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Fix only documents this (fix.diff:67); moving the guard out is a plausible hardening that a maintainer might plant either way.

O9_family: input validation / incomplete extension denylist (CWE-184) leading to dangerous-file upload

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Extend the endsWith list in defaultSanitizer with more PHP extensions, missing interior segments (shell.php.jpg), .htaccess/.shtml, and the rename route.

out_of_scope_notes: addMediaFromUrl fetches arbitrary URLs (SSRF); fix only adds a docs note (fix.diff:54).
SVG rendering via Imagick may resolve external entities; fix only adds a docs note (fix.diff:90).
